name: Parks Closure Status Due to COVID-19: Athletic Facilities
description: This dataset tracks the closure and reopening status of athletic facilities in New York City parks during the COVID-19 pandemic. Each row represents a facility such as a ballfield, court, or sports area, identified by name, property name, field number, borough, park district, and GIS property identifiers. The 24 columns record the facility's primary sport, surface type, dimensions, and whether it is a permit-able space, along with its current status and closure type. Several fields document operational details tied to pandemic safety measures, including approximate dates when facilities closed and reopened, whether red or yellow signage was installed or removed, and whether nets, rims, or goals were removed and later restored. Edit dates and system fields indicate when records were last updated. The data could be used to analyze the timing and geographic distribution of park amenity closures, compare closure patterns across boroughs or sports, assess how quickly facilities reopened, or support public health and parks planning research on access to recreational space during emergencies
